partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Drug-exposed affected-anatomy causal inhibition
results.hypothesis: A causal-gene inhibitor is more likely to treat a disease when the drug is located in an affected anatomy where the gene is expressed.
results.body: drug decreases bound causal gene; drug and Bgee gene expression converge in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines target causality with graph-resident tissue exposure and expression, though drug location is SemMed-derived.
results.trapi_notes: The exposure and expression paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared anatomy identity, provenance, and causal feature edge require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[location:LOCATED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(location.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Top-driver drug-exposed affected-anatomy inhibition
results.hypothesis: Anatomical exposure is more predictive when the inhibited gene is among the disease's top three causal genes.
results.body: R222 plus top-three causal disease-gene evidence rank
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines tissue exposure with a high-ranked causal target, but does not encode disease activity direction.
results.trapi_notes: The paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared anatomy, source, causal rank, and identity constraints require Cypher.

results.name: Contradiction-gated top-driver anatomical exposure
results.hypothesis: A top-driver anatomical exposure rule improves when the drug is not also represented as disrupting the same affected anatomy.
results.body: R223 excluding drug DISRUPTS the matched anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule removes graph-native tissue toxicity evidence from an otherwise causal exposure architecture.
results.trapi_notes: Positive and negative paths are TRAPI-expressible; absence, shared anatomy, provenance, and causal rank require post-processing.

MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[location:LOCATED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)

WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(location.primary_knowledge_sources, [])

results.name: Drug-exposed affected-anatomy GOF correction
results.hypothesis: Direct GOF inhibition is more credible when the drug and target converge in an anatomy affected by the disease.
results.body: drug decreases bound GOF driver; drug location and Bgee driver expression converge in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: Explicit corrective direction is localized by drug exposure, target expression, and disease anatomy.
results.trapi_notes: The paths are TRAPI-expressible; variant form, shared anatomy, provenance, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[location:LOCATED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(location.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.mechanism_rationale: The causal target path is retained, but graph-native tissue disruption provides a countermechanism.
